resources.string: Ready for a Pomodoro focus session
Active — signed timer and enforcement state are healthy
Degraded — a required capability needs attention; the session has not ended
Integrity warning — recovery is required; the session has not ended
Preparing — enforcement has not started yet

Cockblocker redirects selected app launches back to this Home screen, and it can launch the apps you allow straight from this screen. Settings is locked while a session runs unless you allow it as an exception. It cannot guarantee that an app never flashes, and Android, root, ADB, force-stop, safe mode, and device recovery can bypass it. Each focus block ends only when its signed, monotonic timer reaches zero. Breaks unlock apps automatically, and the next focus begins automatically; there is intentionally no early focus release.\n\nAccessibility access is used to read foreground app package names only. Cockblocker does not read screen text, inspect page content, or synthesize taps. Notification access lets Android deliver notification package and key metadata; content and text are discarded, and no notification history is stored. Usage Access exposes recent app-activity events, which may be delayed or incomplete; only the latest foreground package and timestamp are retained in memory. The overlay provides a brief, non-deceptive redirect while an app is blocked. No network or advertising code is used.
Check apps to allow. Unchecked launchable apps are blocked, including Settings unless you allow it here. Apps marked Cannot block are safety-critical and can never be selected for blocking.
Preparing. Do not leave this screen until setup is confirmed.
Session could not be prepared. Setup state has not been changed.
This is a debug build. Install the signed release APK to start a session.
Cockblocker uses foreground app package names to return selected blocked apps to Home. It does not read screen content or control taps.
Cockblocker discards notification content and uses package/key metadata only to cancel selected blocked-app notifications on a best-effort basis.
Cockblocker uses Usage Access only as a delayed fallback for the latest foreground app package. It does not store usage history.

Android’s Usage Access setting exposes recent app-activity events to Cockblocker. Events can be delayed or missing. Cockblocker retains only the latest foreground package and timestamp in memory, never activity history, and never uses it as the sole enforcement layer.
Visible focus-session countdown and integrity health
Optional optimization for supported Android versions. Cockblocker cannot lock the device, wipe data, or change passwords.
